sections.heading: 1. Overview
paragraphs: The meeting went through the kickoff materials, the scope and goals, the method, the schedule, the people and the items to confirm, and discussed the details.

items.title: Scope
items.body: The work proceeds as the kickoff materials set out: the public site's page types, the content migration and the launch in <month>.

items.title: Deliverables and ownership
items.body: The site's source, the design files and the migrated content are delivered to <client> and are <client>'s.

items.title: Minutes
items.body: <organization> writes the minutes of every meeting with decisions and shares them by email.

items.title: Search on the new site
items.body: Whether the current site's search can be kept was asked; the new site is expected to use its own search, with the index rebuilt from the migrated content.

items.title: Staging server
items.body: Two ways of hosting the staging site were described, in the reference table below; the choice is <client>'s.

sections.heading: Reference. Staging server options
rows: A second instance at the current provider
A managed instance at another provider
sections.note: List prices; the provider's quote to be confirmed

items.title: Content owners
items.body: Who at <client> signs off the content of each page type is not yet set.

items.title: Domain access
items.body: Whether <organization> gets access to the domain's DNS before the launch week.

sections.heading: 5. Actions
rows: Name the content owner of each page type
Send the brand files and access to the current site's analytics

sections.heading: 6. Next meeting
rows: First working session. The items to confirm are checked against the current site and the brand files.
